long_comment: The Achilles soreness is a new issue for Johnson, who was a late scratch ahead of tipoff. His next chance to play will come Friday against the Hornets. With the 2025 No. 6 overall pick sidelined, Bilal Coulibaly and Bub Carrington could see increased playing time.

name: Egor Demin
short_comment: Demin has been diagnosed with a right leg bone bruise and will be reevaluated in one week, Ian Begley of SportsNet New York reports Thursday. The injury occurred during Tuesday's game against Boston.
long_comment: Demin appears likely to miss multiple games while recovering from the injury, though Brooklyn has yet to establish a definitive timetable for his return. His absence could open additional backcourt minutes for the Nets' remaining guards. A clearer picture of his availability should emerge following next week's reevaluation.

name: Kawhi Leonard
short_comment: Leonard (knee) is expected to be sidelined for at least three to four weeks, Chris Haynes of NBA TV reports.
long_comment: The extended absence represents a significant setback for Leonard, who will be unavailable for the foreseeable future. His absence should create additional offensive opportunities for Toronto's remaining rotation players, with guys like RJ Barrett, Scottie Barnes and Allen Graves seeing more usage. Leonard's recovery timeline will be worth monitoring, as the reported window represents a minimum absence rather than a firm return date.

name: Egor Demin
short_comment: The Nets exercised Demin's third-year team option for the 2027-28 season, Sharif Phillips-Keaton of USA Today reports Thursday.
long_comment: Brooklyn's decision keeps Demin under contract through the 2027-28 campaign as the organization continues investing in its young backcourt. The move provides additional long-term stability but doesn't directly impact his immediate fantasy outlook. Demin is currently dealing with a right leg bone bruise and is scheduled to be re-evaluated in one week.

name: Kon Knueppel
short_comment: Knueppel (hamstring) will practice with the G League's Greensboro Swarm on Thursday, the Hornets announced.
long_comment: Although the second-year sharpshooter hasn't been given an official timetable, this suggests that he's progressing towards a return. Knueppel will almost certainly be recalled shortly after practice, though an update on his progress may not be given immediately.

name: Meleek Thomas
short_comment: Thomas (foot) is questionable for Thursday's game in Atlanta.
long_comment: Thomas is at risk of sitting out the second end of this back-to-back set. Sam Merrill and Mario Hezonja could get on the streaming radar Thursday, especially if Jaylon Tyson (neck) is sidelined.

name: Jaylon Tyson
short_comment: Tyson (neck) is questionable for Thursday's game against the Hawks.
long_comment: Tyson was a late addition to the injury report due to a cervical strain. He's played a modest role with the second unit to open the season, averaging 9.0 points, 3.3 assists, 3.0 rebounds and 0.8 steals in 21.5 minutes per game.

name: Anthony Edwards
short_comment: Edwards underwent a successful arthroscopic procedure on his right knee Thursday, the Timberwolves announced.
long_comment: Edwards underwent debridement surgery in Minnesota, though the team did not provide a timetable for his return. The star guard is expected to make a full recovery, with additional updates coming as he progresses through rehabilitation. Based on previous reporting from ESPN's Shams Charania, Edwards could miss up to two months. Edwards was off to a scorching start this season, averaging 33.3 points, 4.8 rebounds, 3.5 assists and 2.0 steals across four appearances.

name: Jordan Poole
short_comment: Poole (ankle) is now doubtful for Thursday against the Kings.
long_comment: Poole appears likely to miss the second leg of this back-to-back set. The veteran left Wednesday's game against Denver after just seven minutes and failed to return. His absence could open things up a bit for Bennedict Mathurin.

name: Dennis Schroder
short_comment: Schroder (foot) is questionable for Friday's game against the Wizards.
long_comment: The journeyman floor general is in jeopardy of missing the first leg of this back-to-back set. With Coby White still nursing a hamstring strain, the Hornets would be down to rookie first-rounder Christian Anderson as their lone true point guard if Schroder winds up sitting out.

name: Patrick Williams
short_comment: Williams (adductor) is questionable for Friday's game in Boston.
long_comment: Williams is looking to be available for his season debut Friday. The forward could test out the issue prior to Friday's contest before Chicago clarifies his status.

name: Jalen Smith
short_comment: Smith is questionable for Friday's game against Boston with a left finger sprain.
long_comment: This is a new injury for Chicago's starting center, but he's considered day-to-day. If Smith is held out against Boston, the Bulls could lean more on Zach Collins.

name: Tobe Awaka
short_comment: Awaka (ankle) is questionable for Friday's game in Boston.
long_comment: Awaka continues to battle a left ankle sprain. The rookie big man could go through morning shootaround and pregame warmups before the Bulls update his status.

name: Isaiah Joe
short_comment: Joe (hip) is listed as questionable for Friday's game against Brooklyn.
long_comment: Joe has missed Detroit's last two games due to a right hip contusion, but his questionable designation suggests he could return Friday. The 27-year-old guard has appeared in three games this season, averaging 7.3 points in 13.9 minutes per contest. If Joe remains sidelined, Kevin Huerter, Ronald Holland and Javonte Green could continue seeing additional opportunities off the bench.

name: Reed Sheppard
short_comment: Sheppard (back) is out for Friday's game against the Mavericks.
long_comment: The combo guard is sitting out the front end of this back-to-back set. With Sheppard getting Friday night off, Tari Eason should be able to maintain a prominent role off the bench even if Alperen Sengun (back) returns to action.

name: Marcus Smart
short_comment: Smart (forearm) is questionable for Friday's game against the Mavericks.
long_comment: Smart has missed three consecutive games due to a left forearm strain, but he could return to action Friday. The veteran guard last played Oct. 23 against San Antonio, and his potential return would provide Houston with additional backcourt depth. If Smart remains sidelined, Bogdan Bogdanovic and Bruce Thornton could continue seeing increased opportunities.

name: Alperen Sengun
short_comment: Sengun (back) is questionable for Friday's game against the Mavericks.
long_comment: Sengun has a chance to return from a one-game absence with a back issue. If the star big man indeed gets back in the lineup, less playing time will be available at center for Tari Eason and Clint Capela.

name: Andrew Nembhard
short_comment: Nembhard (neck) is listed as probable for Friday's game against Miami.
long_comment: Nembhard has been battling some lingering neck stiffness, though he's likely to play Friday. He's coming off an 18-point, 14-assist double-double in Wednesday's loss to Philadelphia and should continue taking on increased playmaking responsibilities in Tyrese Haliburton's (hamstring) stead.

name: Aaron Nesmith
short_comment: Nesmith (hamstring) is probable for Friday's game against the Heat.
long_comment: The Pacers continue to monitor Nesmith's health while he works back from a hamstring injury. The sharpshooter has watched his minutes climb incrementally in each of his last three appearances, so it's possible Nesmith will be ready for a larger workload Friday.

name: Ivica Zubac
short_comment: Zubac (ankle) is out for Friday's game against the Heat.
long_comment: The Pacers continue to view the veteran big man as day-to-day due to an ankle sprain. Jay Huff figures to continue to start at center for the Pacers on Friday, while Obi Toppin could see a larger share of the frontcourt minutes.

name: Yanic Konan Niederhauser
short_comment: Niederhauser (foot) had his third-year team option picked up Thursday by the Clippers, Ohm Youngmisuk of ESPN.com reports.
long_comment: With Niederhauser still working back from a foot injury, this move is more about the Clippers' long-term roster planning than any immediate status change. It keeps the young center under team control beyond this season, which was the expectation after Los Angeles spent a first-round pick on Niederhauser a year ago.

name: Simone Fontecchio
short_comment: Fontecchio (illness) is listed as questionable for Friday's game against Indiana.
long_comment: Fontecchio is still under the weather and could hit the inactive list for a second straight game. However, his potential absence wouldn't cause any significant waves in the rotation.

name: Jonathan Isaac
short_comment: Isaac (knee) is out for Friday's game in Toronto.
long_comment: Isaac holds no timetable for a return to an ongoing left knee injury. The oft-injured forward can be considered week-to-week until the Magic update his timeline.

name: Jabari Walker
short_comment: Walker (knee) has been ruled out for Friday's game versus New York.
long_comment: Walker will miss a third consecutive contest due to a left knee issue. His next opportunity to suit up will come Saturday at Charlotte in the second leg of this back-to-back set.

name: Jaylen Brown
short_comment: Brown (knee) is questionable for Friday's game against the Knicks.
long_comment: Brown is in danger of sitting out Friday's showdown with the defending champions, which is the front end of a back-to-back set. More pressure would fall on Tyrese Maxey, Joel Embiid and LeBron James if Brown is out, while Kentavious Caldwell-Pope would be the most likely choice to enter the starting lineup.

name: Robert Williams III
short_comment: Williams (knee) is doubtful for Thursday's game against Memphis due to left knee injury management, according to the Trail Blazers.
long_comment: Williams is trending toward missing Thursday's matchup as Portland continues to manage his left knee. The veteran center's availability has been an ongoing concern in recent seasons, and the team appears to be exercising caution with his workload. If Williams is ruled out, Donovan Clingan could see additional minutes in the frontcourt.

name: Tre Johnson
short_comment: Johnson (Achilles) is listed as questionable for Friday's game against Charlotte.
long_comment: Johnson was a late scratch prior to Wednesday's loss to Cleveland due to right Achilles tightness and could remain on the inactive list Friday. His absence would leave additional minutes available for guys like Bilal Coulibaly, Bub Carrington and Will Riley.

name: Tarik Biberovic
short_comment: Biberovic (heel) is listed as doubtful for Friday's game versus the Rockets.
long_comment: Biberovic has yet to make his NBA debut and is unlikely to do so Friday due to right heel bursitis. However, his potential absence wouldn't affect the rotation.

name: Santi Aldama
short_comment: Aldama (knee) is listed as doubtful for Friday's game against Houston.
long_comment: Aldama appears to be making progress in his recovery from right knee surgery, though he's not expected to make his season debut Friday. His eventual return will leave fewer minutes available for guys like Caleb Martin and Moussa Cisse.

name: Sergio de Larrea
short_comment: De Larrea (knee) is out for Friday's game against the Rockets.
long_comment: De Larrea remains sidelined with a knee sprain, which he suffered during Monday's win in Miami. His next chance to play comes Monday against the Kings.

name: Naji Marshall
short_comment: Marshall is questionable for Friday's game against the Rockets with an illness.
long_comment: Marshall has a chance to return from a two-game absence Friday. Fewer minutes would be open for Zaccharie Risacher off the bench if Marshall is able to return.

name: Rui Hachimura
short_comment: Hachimura (quadriceps) is questionable for Friday's game against Minnesota, Tomer Azarly of ClutchPoints.com reports.
long_comment: Hachimura is in jeopardy of missing a second straight game due to left quad soreness. If the 28-year-old forward is ultimately ruled out, Kobe Sanders, Gradey Dick and Baba Miller would be candidates to see an uptick in minutes.

name: Dejounte Murray
short_comment: Murray (personal) is out for Thursday's game against the Kings, Jim Eichenhofer of the Pelicans' official site reports.
long_comment: Murray is celebrating the birth of his son Thursday, making him a late scratch for Thursday's action. Herbert Jones will start in Murray's stead, per Eichenhofer, and Saddiq Bey could see an uptick in playing time as well.

name: Jordan Poole
short_comment: Poole (ankle) has been ruled out for Thursday's game against the Kings.
long_comment: Poole will miss the second leg of this back-to-back set after spraining his left ankle in Wednesday's loss to Denver. His next chance to play will come Saturday against Atlanta. In the meantime, Bennedict Mathurin and Herbert Jones are candidates for increased burn. With Dejounte Murray (personal) also out, AJ Johnson could enter the rotation.

name: Jose Alvarado
short_comment: Alvarado (ankle) has been ruled out for Friday's game against Philadelphia.
long_comment: Alvarado will miss a fourth straight game with a left ankle sprain, and it's not a positive sign that he's being ruled out a day before tipoff. He can be considered week-to-week until the Knicks offer an update on his status. Tyler Kolek will likely continue seeing increased burn in Alvarado's absence.

name: Meleek Thomas
short_comment: Thomas (foot) has been ruled out for Thursday's game against the Hawks, Serena Winters of FanDuel Sports Network Ohio reports.
long_comment: Thomas will be sidelined for the second leg of the Cavaliers' back-to-back set while nursing a foot injury, and his next opportunity to play is Saturday against the Bucks. The rookie second-rounder averaged 19.5 minutes per game over his last two outings, and that playing time should be absorbed by Sam Merrill and Mario Hezonja.

name: Alpha Diallo
short_comment: Diallo (personal) is listed as questionable for Friday's game against the Suns.
long_comment: Diallo was held out of Wednesday's win over the Pelicans due to personal reasons, and he missed each of the two prior games while nursing a wrist injury. Bryce Hopkins and DeMar DeRozan would continue to see more playing time if Diallo is held out of Friday's contest.

name: Cameron Johnson
short_comment: Johnson (ankle) is questionable for Friday's game against Phoenix.
long_comment: The fact that Johnson has been upgraded to questionable is a sign he's nearing a return, as he was added to the injury report as doubtful ahead of Wednesday's clash before being downgraded to out ahead of tipoff. He hasn't been able to take the floor since suffering a right ankle sprain Oct. 22 against the Thunder.

name: Gui Santos
short_comment: Santos (knee) is listed as doubtful for Friday's game against the Warriors.
long_comment: Santos is expected to miss a second straight game while dealing with left knee tendinitis. If the 24-year-old forward remains sidelined, Georges Niang would likely continue seeing increased playing time.

name: Cameron Carr
short_comment: Carr (oblique) has been ruled out for Friday's game against Golden State.
long_comment: Carr has yet to make his NBA debut while tending to a right oblique strain. His next opportunity to take the court will arrive Sunday against Toronto.

name: Adou Thiero
short_comment: Thiero (knee) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Warriors.
long_comment: Thiero has yet to appear in a regular-season game due to a left knee injury that he picked up during preseason action in early October. His next chance to play is Sunday against the Raptors, but it's unclear when the second-year pro will be cleared to make his 2026-27 debut.

name: Ziaire Williams
short_comment: Williams (foot) is questionable for Friday's game against Golden State.
long_comment: Williams started in each of the first four games of the regular season but was unable to play in Wednesday's 103-87 win over the Clippers due to a foot injury. Jake LaRavia would likely remain in the Lakers' starting five if Williams is not cleared to play Friday.

name: Oso Ighodaro
short_comment: Ighodaro (oblique) is listed as questionable for Friday's game against Denver.
long_comment: Ighodaro hasn't played since Phoenix's regular-season opener due to a right oblique strain, though he's considered day-to-day ahead of Friday's contest. If the big man is cleared to return, Khaman Maluach and Duop Reath could see fewer minutes.

name: Robert Williams III
short_comment: Williams (knee) has been ruled out for Thursday's game against Memphis, Casey Holdahl of the Trail Blazers' official site reports.
long_comment: Williams was initially added to the injury report as doubtful due to a left knee injury, so the fact that he's been ruled out is no surprise. Micah Potter and Yang Hansen could pick up a few additional minutes behind starter Donovan Clingan in Williams' absence.
